operations.summary_zh: 修改平台用户相关设置

fields.name: captcha_secret_id
fields.description: A secret in plaintext (no line breaks, no surrounding spaces), stored encrypted under the control-api credential keyring and never returned; the document shows only <name>_configured and <name>_fingerprint. Omitted keeps the stored one, an empty string clears it. For the CAPTCHA secrets a stored secret cannot coexist with its value.<name>_reference; sending both is refused (<name> invalid), and a reference while the secret stays stored is refused (value.<name>_reference invalid). The CAPTCHA verifier uses the stored secret before the reference.
fields.description_zh: 明文密钥（不含换行、首尾无空格），用 control-api 凭据钥匙串加密保存，从不回显；文档只返回 <名称>_configured 与 <名称>_fingerprint。省略保留原值，空串清除。人机验证密钥的已存值与对应的 value.<名称>_reference 不能同时存在：两者同时填写被拒（<名称> invalid），保留已存密钥时填写引用被拒（value.<名称>_reference invalid）。人机验证优先使用已存密钥，其次才用引用。

fields.name: captcha_turnstile_secret
fields.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret of the registration flow, 16 to 1024 characters without whitespace. A non-empty ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION_TURNSTILE_SECRET wins over it.
fields.description_zh: 注册流程的 Cloudflare Turnstile Secret，16–1024 个字符、不含空白；环境变量 ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION_TURNSTILE_SECRET 非空时优先。

fields.name: kyc_api_key
fields.description: API key of the KYC provider shared by personal and enterprise verification; replaces IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_KYC_API_KEY, which stays the fallback when this is not saved; a change applies to the next KYC request without restarting the control plane.
fields.description_zh: 个人实名与企业认证共用的实名认证服务（KYC）API Key；替换 IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_KYC_API_KEY，未保存时沿用该环境变量；修改后下一次实名认证请求即生效，无需重启控制面。

fields.name: kyc_callback_hmac_key
fields.description: Callback signing key of the KYC provider, canonical padded base64 of 32-128 bytes; replaces IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_KYC_CALLBACK_HMAC_BASE64, which stays the fallback; a change applies without restarting the control plane.
fields.description_zh: 实名认证服务回调验签密钥，32–128 字节的标准带填充 Base64；替换 IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_KYC_CALLBACK_HMAC_BASE64，未保存时沿用该环境变量；修改后无需重启控制面即生效。

fields.name: kyc_object_access_key_id
fields.description: Access key ID of the KYC private object store (identity documents and liveness material); replaces IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_ACCESS_KEY_ID, which stays the fallback; a change applies without restarting the control plane.
fields.description_zh: 实名材料私有对象存储的 Access Key ID；替换 IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_ACCESS_KEY_ID，未保存时沿用该环境变量；修改后无需重启控制面即生效。

fields.name: kyc_object_secret_access_key
fields.description: Secret access key of the KYC private object store; replaces IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, which stays the fallback.
fields.description_zh: 实名材料私有对象存储的 Secret Access Key；替换 IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY，未保存时沿用该环境变量。

fields.name: kyc_object_session_token
fields.description: Optional session token of temporary object store credentials, otherwise like WriteOnlySecret; replaces IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_SESSION_TOKEN, which stays the fallback.
fields.description_zh: 选填，对象存储临时凭据的 Session Token，其余同 WriteOnlySecret；替换 IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_OBJECT_SESSION_TOKEN，未保存时沿用该环境变量。
